summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion for the AI data-center physical-infrastructure node found one high-attention reference leader and three more direct underfollowed candidates. The strongest direct evidence is for Vertiv as the public-market reference leader in critical digital infrastructure, Powell Industries as a switchgear/electrical-distribution supplier with unusually large data-center orders, nVent as a liquid-cooling and power-distribution supplier tied to AI rack-density shifts, and IES Holdings as a data-center electrical/infrastructure installation and custom-engineered-solutions beneficiary. This is a research universe, not a recommendation. Expanded the node universe toward physical AI data-center infrastructure rather than GPUs or software. The highest-quality underfollowed lane candidates found in this pass are Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and behind-the-meter electrical systems, Modine for data-center cooling capacity, and IES Holdings for custom engineered electrical/infrastructure solutions tied to data-center projects. Vertiv remains the reference anchor because it is the obvious large-scale power-and-cooling leader, but its market attention and market cap make it less suitable for the underfollowed lane.
